title: Poésie : Demain dès l'aube
description: Un poème touchant de Victor Hugo.

sentences.french: Demain, dès l'aube, à l'heure où blanchit la campagne,
sentences.english: Tomorrow, at dawn, at the hour when the countryside whitens,

sentences.french: Je partirai. Vois-tu, je sais que tu m'attends.
sentences.english: I will leave. You see, I know that you are waiting for me.

sentences.french: J'irai par la forêt, j'irai par la montagne.
sentences.english: I will go through the forest, I will go through the mountain.

sentences.french: Je ne puis demeurer loin de toi plus longtemps.
sentences.english: I cannot remain far from you any longer.

demeurer.explanation: Literary verb for remaining or staying.

longtemps.explanation: Adverb meaning for a long time.
